title: S2b: tree-sitter dependency and parse wrapper (ADR 0008, DEC-303 (a4))
description: Add @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm 0.3.1 pinned exactly (DEC-303 (a4), ruling 9), verify the shipped LICENSE, record the integrity hash in the lockfile, and a thin src/python/parse.ts: parse a file, count and name ERROR/MISSING nodes, decode invalid UTF-8 before parsing with the replacement counted per file. ESM default import only; the existing single Node bundle must still build.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The dependency is pinned exactly with the integrity hash in the lockfile and the shipped LICENSE text reported
parse.ts reports ERROR/MISSING counts and names; a file with decode replacements is counted per file, never silent
Tests cover PEP 634, 695, 701 and Python 2 syntax probes and the pinned click 7.1.2 corpus (0 ERROR, 0 MISSING) as a committed test or recorded measurement
bun run check and the bundle build are green and whether the wasm asset resolves from the bundled output is reported

implementationNotes: S2b landed 42c01b5 (rules commit a5ba4f3 first). Dependency @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm 0.3.1 pinned exactly; lockfile integrity sha512-RJFoomET6FajjG511fmQxeBQfU6M24a0aFZPqpid+ttIxanWf1VGytBG0UmsGjt07qmIPJS8U31D+aecuCucsQ==; shipped LICENSE MIT (Microsoft Corporation). Worker verified at 42c01b5 under pinned bun 1.4.2: bun run check 283 pass 0 fail, lore check 0/0. Findings: def f(: measures ERROR 0 / MISSING 1 (not an ERROR); x = ) gives ERROR 1. Bundle resolvability: the bundle bakes the build machine absolute path to the runtime wasm, so a clean install fails unless the dependency is external or the wasm is copied (input to S8, not decided). Opus review at 42c01b5 returned CHANGES: R1 malformed sha256 in the corpus record, R2 trees never freed (tree.delete ownership); should-fix a-d; follow-up commit on this branch. INHERIT for S3 and S8: (1) S3 MUST pass BYTES to parsePython: a pre-decoded string containing replacement characters reports 0 decode replacements and limit null, the caller owns lossy conversion; (2) the BOM is stripped on the bytes path only; (3) the tree walk visits every node even when a file is clean (hasError pruning would avoid most of it) and child(i) may be O(i) so very wide nodes may be quadratic: unmeasured, measure in S3 on a wide-node file; (4) column units (UTF-8 bytes vs UTF-16) unmeasured for non-ASCII spans; (5) no size cap or timeout; (6) the Package CI job (scripts/check-package.mjs) is not a required context, S8 must run it to guard the absolute-path bundling risk. SEQUENCING: the dependency sits in dependencies, so a release tag cut from dev before S8 would ship about 22 MB for a feature no command uses; no tag is cut before the Python gate passes, but a dev to main promotion of S2b must not be mistaken for a releasable state.

Opus round 2 at 1eab226: APPROVE (merge conditional on CI green and the push order cleared); verified by the worker under pinned bun 1.4.2: 286 pass, lore 0/0 at 1eab226 (283 was at 42c01b5). NON-BLOCKING should-fixes in ONE follow-up commit on feat/GCLI-73-python-parser BEFORE S3/S4 are dispatched (so they stack on the final S2b head; the leader checks the diff by ref since it touches parse.ts): (1) error-path ownership: parsePython has no try/finally around collectRegions/the hasError read (a throw leaks the tree) and loadParser leaks the new Parser if setLanguage throws (shared and explicit path): catch, delete, rethrow, with tests that force each throw and show the delete call; (2) corpus record line 19 points at <scratch>/click-src/click-1784558e/src/click but a codeload tarball for a commit extracts to click-<full 40-char SHA>, and tar -C needs the directory to exist: confirm what the 1.4.2 re-run actually ran and make the record show exactly that; (3) the child test script resolves the wasm with createRequire(process.cwd() + /index.js): resolve in the parent and interpolate as the explicit-path test does; (4) provenance: exact counts (0xFF 2 ERROR + 1 replacement, NUL 2 ERROR, 250,000-char large file) have no independent record, the comment cites an S2a large-file case that does not exist: label them worker-measured at 1eab226 and note the large input was reshaped 230,000 to 250,000; the NUL test goes through the string path so its decodeReplacements 0 assertion is vacuous: use bytes if the title claims that; (5) S3 inherit: never import the test seam __setGrammarWasmResolverForTest from src/, or guard it with a grep/lint rule once parse.ts is wired.
